VCFtools_approach: Pre-subsetted: VCF was filtered to V2 MSL0 samples BEFORE running Tajima's D (using --keep or bcftools view with a sample list). Monomorphic sites in subset were removed at VCF level.
Pegas_approach: Computational: full VCF loaded (930 pseudo-diploid samples), then rows subset to V2 MSL0 .1 and .2 haplotypes after loading into R.

VCFtools_approach: Used a sample list file (V2.min_proportion0.9_MSL0_samples.diploidised.tsv or equivalent) produced by Dan's pipeline.
Pegas_approach: Uses ADMIXTURE membership TSV (population == 'AM2') + metadata MSL_coverage_rounded == 0, then appends .1 and .2 suffixes.

VCFtools_approach: All VCF-level filters applied during subsetting (e.g., sites monomorphic in V2 MSL0 removed, any quality/coverage filters from the subsetting command).
Pegas_approach: Only filters: p == 0 (all ref in V2 MSL0) or p == 1 (all alt in V2 MSL0) per SNP. No VCF-level quality filters re-applied.

VCFtools_approach: n = 2 × n_samples (standard diploid VCFtools treatment). For 46 pseudo-diploid V2 MSL0 samples: n = 92.
Pegas_approach: n_gene = n_rows × PLOIDY = 46 × 2 = 92. Should match VCFtools.
p = mean(dosage) / PLOIDY = mean(dosage) / 2 per SNP. Mathematically equivalent IF dosage correctly counts alt alleles.
Non-overlapping 50kb: seq(0, chr31_max, by=50000). Should match VCFtools.

VCFtools_approach: N_SNPS in output = number of polymorphic sites in the pre-subsetted VCF within each window.
Pegas_approach: S computed inside function: count of SNPs where 0 < p < 1 within V2 MSL0 rows.

VCFtools_approach: Standard Tajima (1989) implementation in VCFtools source code.
Pegas_approach: Custom R implementation using same Tajima (1989) formula: D = (k - S/a1) / sqrt(e1*S + e2*S*(S-1)).
S counts differ per window (S_diff ranges from -3 to +10 across 24 windows), suggesting different sites pass the monomorphic filter in each approach.
